dataset.name: WTC 1 V8Y non-local shell-failure regularization qualification
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V8X, keep the V8W pairwise contact and free-flight qualification, replace LAW2 local EPSmax deletion with an explicit constant-strain /FAIL/JOHNSON criterion evaluated from /NONLOCAL/MAT plastic strain, and test 100, 50 and 25 mm diagonal mesh convergence plus time-step, thread and projectile-rupture ordering gates. V8Y is a bounded numerical regularization experiment on the same equivalent shell projectile and facade coupon; it is not a JT9D, whole-aircraft or global WTC 1 impact model.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: Directly read from official documentation or a preserved solver output.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: No new NIST result is used as a V8Y target.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No new local-archive claim is used and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The V8W geometry, materials and failure strains remain simplified equivalents rather than measured JT9D or panel-124 fracture data.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic calculation from declared inputs and solver outputs.
evidence_policy.unknown: The physical non-local length, high-rate fracture surfaces and as-built component data remain unknown.

uses: non-eroding diagonal 50-to-25 mm impulse difference of 1.9506 percent
erosion identified as the principal tested mesh-sensitivity driver
unchanged requirement that the deformable subassembly remains unqualified
non-local plastic-strain regularization for mesh size and orientation dependence
LeMAX as the maximum element size targeted for convergence
compatibility with isotropic TYPE1 shells, LAW2 shell-thickness regularization and /FAIL/JOHNSON
constant failure strain when D2 through D5 are zero
Ifail_sh=1 shell deletion at accumulated damage one

inherited_without_change: facade and projectile geometry, masses and constitutive stress-strain curves
two reciprocal pairwise core-cowling TYPE7 interfaces and projectile-to-facade TYPE7 interface
443 mph initial speed, frictionless contact, QEPH shell formulation and output intervals

regularization.material_law: /MAT/PLAS_JOHNS (LAW2), inherited V8W stress-strain curves with EPSmax set to zero
regularization.failure_model: /FAIL/JOHNSON with D1 equal to the declared constant plastic failure strain, D2=D3=D4=D5=0, Ifail_sh=1 and no XFEM
regularization.nonlocal_model: /NONLOCAL/MAT applied to facade, core and cowling materials
regularization.lemax_selection: Predeclared numerical upper bound equal to the coarsest mesh target, so the tested 100, 50 and 25 mm meshes are all at or below LeMAX. It is not a measured material length and is not calibrated to an impulse.

reference_failure_strains.status: Inherited V8W hypotheses, not measured component fracture surfaces

execution_policy.estimated_runtime: Approximately 2 to 6 hours based on the unregistered coarse preflight; actual fine-mesh cost is uncertain.
execution_policy.conditional_execution: Run the 100, 50 and 25 mm diagonal first. Execute the half-time-step, four-thread and low/high projectile-failure cases only if the diagonal passes all predeclared checks including the unchanged 10 percent impulse and final-momentum convergence gates.

predeclared_gates.scope_warning: Passing V8Y would qualify only this declared non-local numerical surrogate. Unknown physical length and fracture data still prevent claiming a JT9D, whole aircraft, global WTC 1 impact, fire, collapse, Blender physics, explosive or thermite mechanism.
